title: Redstrike Surface-Coverage Ledger
description: Per-engagement record of which DISCOVERED attack-surface elements (endpoints, params, identities, forms, API operations, sinks, headers, uploads, auth flows) were actually CONSUMED by an executor vs merely discovered by recon. Category coverage (coverage_ledger.json) proves which vuln CLASSES ran; this proves how much of the real SURFACE each class was tested against. A surface discovered but never tested (and not skipped with a reason) is a recall gap a category-level ledger cannot see. Produced by scripts/surface.py --plan from the recon feeders, updated with --mark as executors consume each element.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the plan/last update.

kind.description: what kind of surface element this is.

value.description: the element itself (path, param name, identity label, sink location...).

routed_to.description: category ids whose executors SHOULD consume this element.

status.description: discovered=enumerated, NOT yet fed to any executor (a gap if still so at close); tested=an executor consumed it; skipped=deliberately not tested (needs reason); n/a=routes to no in-scope category.

consumed_by.description: executor/skill ids that tested this element.
